checks.detail: missing=[]
attempt identity, owner, lifetime, and retry schedule are not implicit
settlement, retry release, and renewal all require the exact live receipt
fixed inputs are deterministic under tests while the owner supplies CSPRNG bytes
expiry observations cannot be undone while caller time remains a separate, explicitly untrusted boundary
restart rejects partial durable receipt metadata
zero-duration, overlong, and otherwise unreachable active states fail restore
backoff has a prior-attempt provenance requirement
current rows prove their minting observation while migrated rows disclose that older schemas discarded it
restart rejects the unreachable state that would otherwise become immediately claimable
ready-at and expiry-at instants are inclusive and zero clock is invalid
zero, overlong, and overflowing leases are rejected before mint
malformed folder, destination, operation, generation, cutpoint, or worker cannot enter state
receipt minting fails closed at both entropy and counter boundaries
the policy does not publish an unvalidated intermediate state
tokens are scoped to one exact durable transition rather than only random bytes
a different receipt is stale while the matching receipt expires exactly at its deadline
renewal preserves attempt identity and cannot revive or extend a claim indefinitely
a stale or expired sender cannot install an unbounded delay over current work
adversarial boundary tests pin the complete live-receipt state machine
both pure authority layers are compiled, independently tested, and included in sanitizer lanes
randomness stays at the process boundary without holding SQLite's single writer slot
claim, renewal, and retry release converge on one re-attested lease publication helper
a sealed revision cannot omit the provenance-bearing policy, clock fence, runtimes, structural audit, or design record
